title: Kentucky AOC-RU-004 Records Check Request
source_context: A July 2026 RTEC email thread asked whether this official state form could replace an older court-record request form in an employment application packet. The thread does not confirm approval or implementation.
currentness: The official Kentucky Court of Justice Legal Forms listing identified AOC-RU-004, Records Check Request, Rev. 12-22 on 2026-09-23. This records what the official listing showed on that date; it does not validate RTEC workflow or employment-screening authority.
handling_constraints: Preserve the official source unchanged; do not customize or remove the Commonwealth seal or AOC form number.
The official Legal Forms guidance says altering a form beyond mere completion is prohibited and may result in civil or criminal liability.
The form contains blank fields for Social Security number, driver's-license number, date of birth, and other sensitive identifiers. Never store completed forms or applicant data in this repository.
This form's presence does not establish that it is approved or required for RTEC use. Verify current legal and operational requirements before use.
